preconditions.description: Length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of string s matches the given integer n.
Length of the string t is between 1 and n.
The length of string t matches the given integer m.
The maximum number of pieces x is between 1 and 30.

postconditions.expression: f(s, t) <= x if return_value == 'YES' else f(s, t) > x
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then the minimum number of substrings f(s, t) is less than or equal to x. If the output is 'NO', then f(s, t) is greater than x.
